Skill assessment tools for gardening:
1. Plant Growth Journal: Log daily/weekly measurements of height, leaf count, and flowering status.
2. Pest & Disease Tracker: Record incidents, treatments applied, and outcomes to assess diagnostic and remediation skills.
3. Harvest Yield Metrics: Track weight, quantity, and quality of produce to measure productivity and efficiency.
4. Seasonal Planning Review: Compare planned vs. actual planting/harvest dates to evaluate timing and scheduling accuracy.
5. Soil & Care Log: Document watering, fertilizing, and soil amendments to assess consistency and knowledge of plant needs.
